title: Open-restriction vanishing in the open-injective proper argument
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring. Let B,D,C,E be schemes and p:B→D and r:C→E be proper, and let k:C→B and i:E→D be quasi-compact open immersions satisfying k≫p=r≫i. For any injective J of modules over the constant A-sheaf on C and any positive natural number q, the pullback along i of H^q(Rp_*(k_!J[0])) is zero. The operations are the ordinary uncompleted intrinsic constant-ring operations [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations, def-weil-extension-by-zero, def-sp-injective-resolutions].

source.place: Docstring proof steps 1--3 of isZero_higherDirectImage_open_injective_of_proper; the Stacks 0F7B etale argument is only an analogue.

proof.text: Form V=B×_D E with b:V→B and s:V→E, and t=(k,r):C→V. Then b and t are open immersions. Properness of r and separatedness of s make t proper, so its image is closed. The clopen extension by zero is the direct image. The latter preserves injectivity as right adjoint to exact inverse image. Transport this through the canonical coefficient realization equivalences to obtain an injective Jv=t_!J.

Composition of open extension and the inverse of the open adjunction unit identify b^*k_!J with Jv. Apply the derived open-restriction isomorphism and exact-functor compatibility with the single embedding. This gives i^*Rp_*(k_!J[0])≅Rs_*(Jv[0]).

The intrinsic module category is Grothendieck and admits injective resolutions. In positive degree the homology of Rs_*(Jv[0]) is the classical right derived functor, which vanishes on injectives. Commute exact pullback with homology and transport from the canonical fixed-scalar pullback to the tensor-normalized pullback.

theorem isZero_openRestriction_higherDirectImage_open_injective_of_proper
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {B D C E : Scheme.{u}} (p : B ⟶ D) (r : C ⟶ E)
    (k : C ⟶ B) (i : E ⟶ D)
    [IsProper p] [IsProper r]
    [IsOpenImmersion k] [QuasiCompact k]
    [IsOpenImmersion i] [QuasiCompact i]
    (hcomm : k ≫ p = r ≫ i)
    (J : proEtaleRingModules C (proEtaleConstantRing C A)) [Injective J]
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) :
    IsZero ((proEtaleConstantRingPullback A i).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (proEtaleRingModules D (proEtaleConstantRing D A)) (q : ℤ)).obj
        ((proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage p A).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (proEtaleRingModules B (proEtaleConstantRing B A)) 0).obj
            ((sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero k A).obj J)))))
